RefPreview's TRIGGER_SELECTOR matches [data-dispatch-href] (RefPreview.tsx:41) and routeOf reads it unbounded (:171-174), so the hover card still shows the document: the dashboard still presents a reference the server does not record. The deep pass rendered MarkdownBody at the head and saw both anchors as {href:"", data-dispatch-href:…}. The new tests check only the words and the missing data-dispatch-ref. Fix: when the target is a dispatch:// URL left as text and the bounded read names nothing, replace the anchor with its words as text (as a bare dispatch:// past the bounds already renders), and make both tests assert no link and no hover trigger.
